quarantine.reason: Wall-clock ratios measured against fake-indexeddb on shared CI hardware. It fails intermittently (largeTime < max(smallTime*25, 20) on a loaded runner) and, when it passes, it certifies the fake rather than IndexedDB. Requirement 112 §4 moves cana to headless Cypress with no shims; these shape assertions belong there, against a real engine, and are rewritten as part of that work.
